{{Top|leg|title=''Vernal''-class freighter}}
The '''''Vernal''-class freighter''' was a class of [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Altisian Jedi]] sect operated out of one such [[Starship/Legends|starship]] named ''[[Wookiee Gunner]]''.
